countries.name: Algeria
countries.fact: Algeria is the largest country in Africa, and most of it is the Sahara Desert.

countries.name: Angola
countries.fact: Angola's coast runs for about 1,600 kilometres along the Atlantic Ocean.

countries.name: Benin
countries.fact: The old kingdom of Dahomey, in what is now Benin, was famous for its fierce warrior guards.

countries.name: Botswana
countries.fact: The Okavango Delta in Botswana floods every year and fills with wildlife.

countries.name: Burkina Faso
countries.fact: The name Burkina Faso means "land of honest people".

countries.name: Burundi
countries.fact: Burundi is on the shore of Lake Tanganyika, one of the deepest lakes in the world.

countries.name: Cabo Verde
countries.fact: Cabo Verde is a group of ten volcanic islands in the Atlantic Ocean.

countries.name: Cameroon
countries.fact: Cameroon is nicknamed "Africa in miniature" because it has deserts, rainforests and mountains.

countries.name: Central African Republic
countries.fact: The Central African Republic is in the middle of Africa and has no coast.

countries.name: Chad
countries.fact: Lake Chad, in the country of Chad, has shrunk a lot over the last fifty years.

countries.name: Comoros
countries.fact: Comoros is made of volcanic islands in the Indian Ocean, and it grows a lot of the world's ylang-ylang for perfume.

countries.name: Republic of the Congo
countries.fact: Brazzaville and Kinshasa, the capitals of the two Congos, are the closest capital cities facing each other on a river.

countries.name: DR Congo
countries.fact: The Congo River in DR Congo is the deepest river in the world.

countries.name: Côte d'Ivoire
countries.fact: Côte d'Ivoire grows more cocoa than any other country, so it helps make a lot of the world's chocolate.

countries.name: Djibouti
countries.fact: Lake Assal in Djibouti is one of the saltiest lakes on Earth.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.fact: The great pyramids of Giza in Egypt are about 4,500 years old.

countries.name: Equatorial Guinea
countries.fact: Equatorial Guinea is the only country in Africa where Spanish is an official language.

countries.name: Eritrea
countries.fact: Eritrea has a long coastline on the Red Sea.

countries.name: Eswatini
countries.fact: Eswatini is one of the smallest countries in Africa and is ruled by a king.

countries.name: Ethiopia
countries.fact: Ethiopia is where coffee was first discovered, according to an old legend about a goat herder.

countries.name: Gabon
countries.fact: Most of Gabon is covered by rainforest, and it is home to many forest elephants.

countries.name: Gambia
countries.fact: The Gambia is a long, thin country that follows the Gambia River.

countries.name: Ghana
countries.fact: Ghana was the first country in sub-Saharan Africa to become independent, in 1957.

countries.name: Guinea
countries.fact: Three great rivers, the Niger, the Gambia and the Senegal, start in Guinea.

countries.name: Guinea-Bissau
countries.fact: The Bijagós islands off Guinea-Bissau are home to turtles and hippos that swim in the sea.

countries.name: Kenya
countries.fact: Every year, huge herds of wildebeest cross the Mara River between Kenya and Tanzania.

countries.name: Lesotho
countries.fact: Lesotho is completely surrounded by South Africa and sits high in the mountains.

countries.name: Liberia
countries.fact: Liberia's capital, Monrovia, is named after the American president James Monroe.

countries.name: Libya
countries.fact: Most of Libya is desert, and it has a long coast on the Mediterranean Sea.

countries.name: Madagascar
countries.fact: Lemurs live wild only on Madagascar, the fourth biggest island in the world.

countries.name: Malawi
countries.fact: Lake Malawi has more kinds of fish than any other lake in the world.

countries.name: Mali
countries.fact: Timbuktu, in Mali, was once a famous trading city with a great library.

countries.name: Mauritania
countries.fact: Mauritania has trains over two kilometres long that carry iron ore across the Sahara.

countries.name: Mauritius
countries.fact: The dodo, a bird that could not fly, once lived only on Mauritius.

countries.name: Morocco
countries.fact: Marrakesh in Morocco is called the Red City because of its sandy-red walls.

countries.name: Mozambique
countries.fact: Mozambique has about 2,500 kilometres of coast on the Indian Ocean.

countries.name: Namibia
countries.fact: The Namib Desert in Namibia is one of the oldest deserts in the world.

countries.name: Niger
countries.fact: The Niger River bends through Niger, and the Sahara covers most of the north.

countries.name: Nigeria
countries.fact: Nigeria has more people than any other country in Africa.

countries.name: Rwanda
countries.fact: Rwanda is called the land of a thousand hills, and mountain gorillas live there.

countries.name: São Tomé and Príncipe
countries.fact: São Tomé and Príncipe are two small islands, and they grow lots of cocoa.

countries.name: Senegal
countries.fact: Lake Retba in Senegal is pink because of tiny algae that live in the salty water.

countries.name: Seychelles
countries.fact: The Seychelles are 115 islands and are home to the giant Aldabra tortoise.

countries.name: Sierra Leone
countries.fact: Freetown, the capital of Sierra Leone, was founded as a home for people freed from slavery.

countries.name: Somalia
countries.fact: Somalia has the longest coastline of any country on mainland Africa.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.fact: South Africa has three capital cities, one for each part of its government.

countries.name: South Sudan
countries.fact: South Sudan became the world's newest country in 2011.

countries.name: Sudan
countries.fact: The Blue Nile and the White Nile meet in Khartoum, the capital of Sudan, to form the River Nile.

countries.name: Tanzania
countries.fact: Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa, is in Tanzania.

countries.name: Togo
countries.fact: Togo is a narrow country, only about 50 to 150 kilometres wide in most places.

countries.name: Tunisia
countries.fact: Some scenes of the Star Wars films were filmed in the Tunisian desert.

countries.name: Uganda
countries.fact: Lake Victoria, the biggest lake in Africa, touches Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania.

countries.name: Zambia
countries.fact: Victoria Falls, one of the biggest waterfalls in the world, is on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe.

countries.name: Zimbabwe
countries.fact: The ruins of Great Zimbabwe are an ancient stone city that gave the country its name.

countries.name: Afghanistan
countries.fact: Afghanistan is a land of high mountains, including the Hindu Kush range.

countries.name: Armenia
countries.fact: Armenia was one of the first countries to make Christianity its official religion, in the year 301.

countries.name: Azerbaijan
countries.fact: Baku, in Azerbaijan, is on the Caspian Sea, the biggest lake in the world.

countries.name: Bahrain
countries.fact: Bahrain is an island country in the Persian Gulf, famous long ago for its pearls.

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.fact: Bangladesh is home to the Sundarbans, the largest mangrove forest in the world.

countries.name: Bhutan
countries.fact: Bhutan measures its success by "Gross National Happiness".

countries.name: Brunei
countries.fact: Brunei is a small country on the island of Borneo, with the rest of the island split between two other countries.

countries.name: Cambodia
countries.fact: Angkor Wat in Cambodia is the largest religious building in the world.

countries.name: China
countries.fact: The Great Wall of China is thousands of kilometres long.

countries.name: Georgia
countries.fact: People in Georgia have been making wine for about 8,000 years.

countries.name: India
countries.fact: India has more than a billion people, and the Taj Mahal is one of its most famous buildings.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.fact: Indonesia is made up of more than 17,000 islands.

countries.name: Iran
countries.fact: Iran was once called Persia, and it is home to one of the oldest civilisations in the world.

countries.name: Iraq
countries.fact: Long ago, the first cities and the first writing appeared in the land that is now Iraq.

countries.name: Israel
countries.fact: Israel's Dead Sea is so salty that people float easily on top of it.

countries.name: Japan
countries.fact: Japan is made up of four main islands and thousands of smaller ones, and it has Mount Fuji.

countries.name: Jordan
countries.fact: The ancient rose-red city of Petra was carved into the cliffs in Jordan.

countries.name: Kazakhstan
countries.fact: Kazakhstan is the biggest country in the world with no coast.

countries.name: Kuwait
countries.fact: Kuwait is a small country at the top of the Persian Gulf.

countries.name: Kyrgyzstan
countries.fact: More than 90 percent of Kyrgyzstan is covered by mountains.

countries.name: Laos
countries.fact: Laos is the only country in Southeast Asia with no coast.

countries.name: Lebanon
countries.fact: A cedar tree is on the flag of Lebanon, and its cedar forests are thousands of years old.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.fact: The Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur were the tallest buildings in the world from 1998 to 2004.

countries.name: Maldives
countries.fact: The Maldives are made of coral islands, and they are the lowest country in the world.

countries.name: Mongolia
countries.fact: Mongolia is called the land of the blue sky, and many families still live in round tents called gers.

countries.name: Myanmar
countries.fact: Myanmar is also called Burma, and thousands of old temples stand at Bagan.

countries.name: Nepal
countries.fact: Mount Everest, the highest mountain in the world, is on the border of Nepal and China.

countries.name: North Korea
countries.fact: North Korea shares the Korean peninsula with South Korea.

countries.name: Oman
countries.fact: Oman has been famous for frankincense, a sweet-smelling tree resin, for thousands of years.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.fact: K2, the second highest mountain in the world, is in Pakistan.

countries.name: Philippines
countries.fact: The Philippines is made of more than 7,000 islands.

countries.name: Qatar
countries.fact: Qatar is a small peninsula that sticks out into the Persian Gulf.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.fact: Most of Saudi Arabia is desert, and it holds the holy city of Mecca.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.fact: Singapore is both a city and a country, on one small island.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.fact: The K-pop music and the game of taekwondo both come from South Korea.

countries.name: Sri Lanka
countries.fact: Sri Lanka is shaped like a teardrop and is famous for its tea.

countries.name: Syria
countries.fact: Damascus, in Syria, is one of the oldest cities in the world that people still live in.

countries.name: Tajikistan
countries.fact: Most of Tajikistan is mountains, and it has some of the world's longest glaciers.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.fact: Elephants are the national animal of Thailand.

countries.name: Timor-Leste
countries.fact: Timor-Leste, also called East Timor, became independent in 2002.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.fact: Turkey is a bridge between two continents, because the city of Istanbul sits in both Europe and Asia.

countries.name: Turkmenistan
countries.fact: The Darvaza gas crater in Turkmenistan has been burning like a giant fire pit for decades.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.fact: Dubai, in the United Arab Emirates, has the tallest building in the world, the Burj Khalifa.

countries.name: Uzbekistan
countries.fact: Samarkand, in Uzbekistan, was a famous stop on the ancient Silk Road.

countries.name: Vietnam
countries.fact: Ha Long Bay in Vietnam has thousands of limestone islands rising from the sea.

countries.name: Yemen
countries.fact: Sana'a, in Yemen, is known for its tall old houses decorated with white patterns.

countries.name: Albania
countries.fact: Albania has thousands of small concrete bunkers dotted around the countryside.

countries.name: Andorra
countries.fact: Andorra is a tiny country high in the Pyrenees mountains between France and Spain.

countries.name: Austria
countries.fact: Many famous composers, including Mozart, lived and worked in Austria.

countries.name: Belarus
countries.fact: Belarus is home to the Białowieża Forest, where the European bison still lives wild.

countries.name: Belgium
countries.fact: Belgium is famous for its chocolate, waffles and fries.

countries.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
countries.fact: The Old Bridge in Mostar, Bosnia and Herzegovina, is famous for the divers who leap off it.

countries.name: Bulgaria
countries.fact: Bulgaria is the world's biggest producer of rose oil, used to make perfume.

countries.name: Croatia
countries.fact: Croatia has more than a thousand islands in the Adriatic Sea.

countries.name: Cyprus
countries.fact: Cyprus is an island in the Mediterranean Sea, and in old stories it is the birthplace of the goddess Aphrodite.

countries.name: Czechia
countries.fact: Czechia is also called the Czech Republic, and its capital Prague has a famous old astronomical clock.

countries.name: Denmark
countries.fact: LEGO bricks were invented in Denmark.

countries.name: Estonia
countries.fact: Estonia is a leader in technology, and Skype was created by Estonian programmers.

countries.name: Finland
countries.fact: Finland has about 180,000 islands and thousands of lakes.

countries.name: France
countries.fact: The Eiffel Tower in Paris is about 330 metres tall.

countries.name: Germany
countries.fact: Germany has more than 1,500 kinds of sausage, and its autobahn has parts with no speed limit.

countries.name: Greece
countries.fact: The first Olympic Games were held in ancient Greece.

countries.name: Hungary
countries.fact: The Rubik's Cube was invented in Hungary in 1974.

countries.name: Iceland
countries.fact: Iceland is called the land of fire and ice, because it has volcanoes and glaciers.

countries.name: Ireland
countries.fact: Ireland is called the Emerald Isle because it is so green.

countries.name: Italy
countries.fact: Italy is shaped like a boot, and pizza comes from the city of Naples.

countries.name: Latvia
countries.fact: Latvia has more than half of its land covered in forest.

countries.name: Liechtenstein
countries.fact: Liechtenstein is one of the smallest countries in the world, only about 25 kilometres long.

countries.name: Lithuania
countries.fact: Lithuania is famous for amber, a golden stone made from ancient tree sap.

countries.name: Luxembourg
countries.fact: Luxembourg is one of the smallest countries in Europe, and its capital has the same name.

countries.name: Malta
countries.fact: Malta is a small island country with some of the oldest stone temples in the world.

countries.name: Moldova
countries.fact: Moldova has an enormous underground wine cellar with hundreds of kilometres of tunnels.

countries.name: Monaco
countries.fact: Monaco is the second smallest country in the world, after the Vatican City.

countries.name: Montenegro
countries.fact: Montenegro means "black mountain", named after its dark forested mountains.

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.fact: About a quarter of the Netherlands is below sea level, and it has more bicycles than people.

countries.name: North Macedonia
countries.fact: Lake Ohrid, shared by North Macedonia and Albania, is one of the oldest lakes in the world.

countries.name: Norway
countries.fact: Norway has deep sea inlets called fjords, and in summer the sun hardly sets in the far north.

countries.name: Poland
countries.fact: Poland has the Wieliczka Salt Mine, where there are statues and chapels made of salt.

countries.name: Portugal
countries.fact: Portugal is the country where most of the world's cork comes from.

countries.name: Romania
countries.fact: Bran Castle in Romania is often linked to the story of Dracula.

countries.name: Russia
countries.fact: Russia is the biggest country in the world and spans eleven time zones.

countries.name: San Marino
countries.fact: San Marino is one of the oldest countries in the world, said to be founded in the year 301.

countries.name: Serbia
countries.fact: Belgrade, in Serbia, is where two great rivers, the Danube and the Sava, meet.

countries.name: Slovakia
countries.fact: Slovakia has more castles and chateaux per person than almost any other country.

countries.name: Slovenia
countries.fact: Slovenia has more than 10,000 caves, and the beautiful Lake Bled.

countries.name: Spain
countries.fact: In Spain, people eat dinner late, and they celebrate with a tomato-throwing festival called La Tomatina.

countries.name: Sweden
countries.fact: Sweden has more than 95,000 lakes, and the Nobel Prizes are given out in its capital.

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.fact: Switzerland is famous for its chocolate, cheese and watches, and the Alps.

countries.name: Ukraine
countries.fact: Ukraine is the largest country that lies entirely in Europe.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.fact: The United Kingdom is made up of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

countries.name: Vatican City
countries.fact: The Vatican City is the smallest country in the world and sits inside the city of Rome.

countries.name: Antigua and Barbuda
countries.fact: Antigua is said to have a beach for every day of the year.

countries.name: Bahamas
countries.fact: The Bahamas are about 700 islands, with clear turquoise water.

countries.name: Barbados
countries.fact: Barbados is the birthplace of the singer Rihanna, and its islanders love cricket.

countries.name: Belize
countries.fact: The Belize Barrier Reef is the second biggest coral reef in the world.

countries.name: Canada
countries.fact: Canada has more lakes than the rest of the world put together.

countries.name: Costa Rica
countries.fact: Costa Rica has no army, and it is full of rainforest and wildlife.

countries.name: Cuba
countries.fact: Cuba is the biggest island in the Caribbean Sea.

countries.name: Dominica
countries.fact: Dominica is called the nature island of the Caribbean, with a boiling lake.

countries.name: Dominican Republic
countries.fact: The Dominican Republic shares an island, Hispaniola, with Haiti.

countries.name: El Salvador
countries.fact: El Salvador is the smallest country in Central America.

countries.name: Grenada
countries.fact: Grenada is called the Spice Island because it grows so much nutmeg.

countries.name: Guatemala
countries.fact: Guatemala was the home of the ancient Maya, who built great stone cities like Tikal.

countries.name: Haiti
countries.fact: Haiti was the first country in the world to be founded by people who had freed themselves from slavery.

countries.name: Honduras
countries.fact: The ancient Mayan city of Copán, with its stone stairway of writing, is in Honduras.

countries.name: Jamaica
countries.fact: Jamaica is the home of reggae music, and the runner Usain Bolt.

countries.name: Mexico
countries.fact: Chocolate and corn tortillas both come from Mexico, and so does the ancient pyramid of Chichén Itzá.

countries.name: Nicaragua
countries.fact: Nicaragua is the biggest country in Central America and has many volcanoes.

countries.name: Panama
countries.fact: The Panama Canal lets ships cross between the Atlantic and Pacific oceans.

countries.name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
countries.fact: Saint Kitts and Nevis is the smallest country in the Americas.

countries.name: Saint Lucia
countries.fact: Saint Lucia has two huge cone-shaped mountains called the Pitons.

countries.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
countries.fact: The Grenadines are a chain of small, beautiful islands in the Caribbean.

countries.name: Trinidad and Tobago
countries.fact: Trinidad and Tobago is where the steelpan, a musical instrument made from oil drums, was invented.

countries.name: United States
countries.fact: The United States has 50 states, and Alaska is the biggest.

countries.name: Argentina
countries.fact: Argentina is the home of the tango dance and the Andes mountain Aconcagua, the highest in the Americas.

countries.name: Bolivia
countries.fact: Bolivia has the Uyuni Salt Flat, the biggest mirror-like salt desert in the world.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.fact: Brazil has most of the Amazon rainforest and has won the football World Cup five times.

countries.name: Chile
countries.fact: Chile is a very long, thin country, over 4,000 kilometres from top to bottom.

countries.name: Colombia
countries.fact: Colombia is famous for its coffee, emeralds and colourful butterflies.

countries.name: Ecuador
countries.fact: Ecuador is named after the equator, and the Galápagos Islands belong to it.

countries.name: Guyana
countries.fact: Kaieteur Falls in Guyana is one of the most powerful waterfalls in the world.

countries.name: Paraguay
countries.fact: Paraguay has no coast, and people there speak both Spanish and a native language, Guaraní.

countries.name: Peru
countries.fact: The ancient city of Machu Picchu is high in the mountains of Peru.

countries.name: Suriname
countries.fact: Suriname is the smallest country in South America, and most of it is rainforest.

countries.name: Uruguay
countries.fact: Uruguay hosted and won the very first football World Cup, in 1930.

countries.name: Venezuela
countries.fact: Angel Falls in Venezuela is the tallest waterfall in the world.

countries.name: Australia
countries.fact: Kangaroos and koalas live wild only in Australia.

countries.name: Fiji
countries.fact: Fiji is made of more than 300 islands in the Pacific Ocean.

countries.name: Kiribati
countries.fact: Kiribati is the only country in the world in all four hemispheres.

countries.name: Marshall Islands
countries.fact: The Marshall Islands are a ring of coral islands, called atolls, in the Pacific Ocean.

countries.name: Micronesia
countries.fact: Micronesia is made of more than 600 small islands, with giant stone coins on Yap.

countries.name: Nauru
countries.fact: Nauru is the smallest island country in the world.

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.fact: New Zealand has more sheep than people, and the kiwi bird cannot fly.

countries.name: Palau
countries.fact: Palau has a lake full of harmless jellyfish that people can swim with.

countries.name: Papua New Guinea
countries.fact: Papua New Guinea has over 800 languages, more than any other country.

countries.name: Samoa
countries.fact: Samoa moved across the international date line in 2011 and skipped a whole day.

countries.name: Solomon Islands
countries.fact: The Solomon Islands are a chain of nearly 1,000 islands in the Pacific Ocean.

countries.name: Tonga
countries.fact: Tonga is a kingdom made of about 170 islands in the Pacific Ocean.

countries.name: Tuvalu
countries.fact: Tuvalu is one of the smallest countries in the world, with only about 11,000 people.

countries.name: Vanuatu
countries.fact: Vanuatu has an active volcano, Mount Yasur, that people can watch erupt.
